rows.grounds: numeral element qualifying the following thousands
locative plural of sahasra, indicating quantity and location
compound of yoni and yantra in locative plural
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: Beings are situated within these womb-mechanisms.
These beings are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms suffer torment.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
